Indian Railways announces changes to ticketing and rules from July 1

Indian Railways is set to implement new rules affecting passengers starting July 1. These changes will impact aspects of confirmed tickets, fines, and reserved coaches. Additionally, the IRCTC website is scheduled for an upgrade on July 15, with potential changes to its booking system.
